purpose: This run completed all 30 configured epochs on a Tesla T4 without a training error and selected epoch 28 using the validation composite score (0.7061). It removed deterministic right-knee canonicalization and instead exposed the model to both orientations with a training-only horizontal flip (p=0.50). It also added mild gamma correction (0.90-1.10, p=0.20) while retaining mild rotation, brightness/contrast jitter, CLAHE, a small random erasing region, and the original 12x12 five-map native-CAM head.
